protocol: The full 96-run mode campaign is cut to 25%: six evenly spaced genomes per panel. Every record is written as its canonical flat sequence (headers removed, uppercased, non-ACGT masked to A). Mode S compresses each target alone with EIMDL --single, JARVIS3 -l 7, and original GraSS -e2 on the identical bytes. Mode R compresses each target with EIMDL --panel against the other N-1 genomes and --exclude <target>. JARVIS3 and GraSS expose no reference mode, so their columns are not a like-for-like baseline for Mode R. Every archive is decompressed in a fresh container and checked against the target's exact bytes and SHA-256.
